title_original: Public Art Abu Dhabi Biennial 2026 Announces Artists

blocks.text: The Department of Culture and Tourism – Abu Dhabi (DCT Abu Dhabi) has announced the artists for the second edition of the Public Art Abu Dhabi Biennial. Under the artistic direction of Elvira Dyangani Ose, over 20 artists will participate across four key locations in Abu Dhabi and Al Ain. The theme, Home: A Glossary for a Communal Sense of Place , builds on Dyangani Ose ’s knowledge of community-engaged public spaces and delves into the notion of ‘home’ as a fluctuating, collective condition rather than a fixed state or location. Participating artists:

Al Ain: Asunción Molinos Gordo M’barek Bouchichi Reena Saini Kallat Roudhah Al Mazrouei Abu Dhabi: Akram Zaatari Jean-Marie Appriou Kapwani Kiwanga Khalid Albanna Nari Ward Shama Al Hamed Vica Pacheco Yinka Shonibare blaxTARLINES KUMASI Céleste Boursier-Mougenot Elena del Rivero Ibrahim Mahama Iván Argote Laure Provost Marinella Senatore Mercedes Azpilicueta Serge Attukwei Clotty
Public Art Abu Dhabi Biennial 2026 will run from 23 October until 15 February 2027
